title: Origin story: Emberlyn
description: Emberlyn was the keeper of the great hall's hearth for sixty years, and she learned what every fire-tender knows: a hearth is a heart. When the hall burned in the war, she carried its last ember across the mountains in a lantern, and rekindled not just the hall but the whole valley's hearths from that single flame.
